title: Week 14 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “political party”?
options: An organization seeking to influence government by electing candidates and coordinating public policy.
A reward, penalty, rule, or condition that changes the costs or benefits of an action.
The channels through which monetary policy affects financial conditions, spending, employment, and prices.
The share of an eligible or registered population that casts a ballot.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 14 inquiry?
options: A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student reports a poll as an estimate with dates, population, method, and uncertainty rather than as a direct measurement of all citizens.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
